description: This Java class 'RateWriteServiceImpl' implements the 'RateWriteService' interface, providing functionalities for creating and updating 'Rate' entities within the Fineract portfolio module. It handles JSON commands to persist Rate data, manages user approval associations, and includes exception handling for data integrity violations.

classes.name: RateWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements rate creation and update functionalities, including data integrity handling and user authorization, within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createRate
methods.description: Creates and persists a new Rate entity based on JSON command input, handling user authorization and data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateRate
methods.description: Updates an existing Rate entity identified by rateId using JSON command data, managing approval user associations and data integrity checks.

methods.name: handleRateDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles specific data integrity violations, throwing detailed exceptions or logging unknown issues.
